description: 指定避難所・指定緊急避難場所一覧(福岡都市圏共通フォーマット [evacuation shelters and public facilities] (series on BODIK ODCS) is a series of datasets listed in BODIK Open Data Catalogue Service (data.bodik.jp), Japanese local governments, an open data portal, published or maintained by BODIK (Open Data Catalogue Service of Japanese local governments). 糸島市の指定避難所・指定緊急避難場所を掲載しています。 データは福岡都市圏共通フォーマットに従って作成しています。. Coverage: Japan. The portal lists 6 near-identical datasets in this series (one per municipality, prefecture, year, month or site), grouped in this record; the first few are linked. The datasets are filed under 6 publishers. Its tags are 位置情報, 災害, 糸島市, 避難所. It offers 2 resource(s) in csv, pdf. The portal shows 2024-05-07 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Japanese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Creative Commons CCZero. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. Suitability for infrastructure simulation has not been checked. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-jp-bodik-portal.
